paragraphs.text:
By the vacant look in her staring eyes, by the white streaks in 
her once-auburn hair, you realize that Sylvia has gone quite mad 
from her ordeal. The sasquatches move her around camp like a 
life-sized doll, placing her beside you under a rock overhang. 
She ignores your attempts at communication.
